notes:
Summary and current status:
- Account: Nebulon builds personalization and ad-selection infra for low-latency bidding and on-site customization. Very sensitive to tail latency and per-request cost.
- Primary ask: consistent p95 latency <100ms for short-chat + reranking flows, 500-1k TPS for embeddings/rerank batch windows, aggressive cost targets (reducing token cost by 3x vs current baseline).
- Perf targets and constraints:
  * p50 target: 25-40ms; p95 target: <100ms (end-to-end from API call to model token emission).
  * typical prompt length: 16-64 tokens; rerank context size: 128 tokens.
  * batch windows: sub-10ms dynamic batching desired for chat; larger 50-200ms windows acceptable for rerank.
  * throughput bias: spiky traffic with frequent microbursts during campaign launches.
- Model preferences: open-weights family, prefer quantized variants (int8 or q4_0) for cost; fallback to fp16 LLM variant only for high-quality responses. Need model-switch routing by latency/cost tier.
- Optimization interest: Redwood Optimize features (batching/caching/quantization) flagged as must-evaluate. Want automated batch sizing suggestions + KV prefix cache for repeated prefixes.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histograms, and trace hooks are critical for validating perf gains.
- Security/compliance: VPC + SSO (SAML), KMS for key management, retention controls for request logging; data residency for EU-backed customers during campaigns.
- POC plan (agreed on call 2026-02-28):
  1) Day 0-1: baseline collection — run Nebulon traffic replay against Redwood hosted endpoints to capture p50/p95 and token counts (NEB-FF replay tool).
  2) Day 2: Dedicated pool smoke test — deploy 2 dedicated instances with 2 model variants (quantized & fp16) and validate throughput.
  3) Day 3: Optimize tuning — apply Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching windows, cache TTLs, quant profiles) and re-run replay.
  4) Deliverable: perf matrix (latency/cost by model/config) + recommended rollout plan for production (canary + A/B).
- Recent interactions:
  * 2026-02-18 email thread: initial pricing ask + SAML checklist (gmail.thread.2026-02-21.1a2b3c).
  * 2026-02-28 discovery call (ff_2026-02-28_9312): engineering demo; quoted 2-day POC.
  * 2026-03-03 internal security questionnaire submitted (drive://nebulon/sec/security-checklist-redwood.pdf).
- Quotes / snippets from Nebulon engineering:
  * "We cannot accept variable p95 spikes during campaign spikes — needs graceful degradation to cheaper model tiers without user-visible timeouts."
  * "If auto-batching can preserve sub-100ms p95 while aggregating requests, we win on both cost and UX."
- Risks / open items:
  * Legal: data residency clause for EU campaigns requires signoff (SEC-1290).
  * Infra procurement: Nebulon's procurement cycle expects a dedicated contract + SLA; budget sign-off scheduled for April.
  * Unknown: effect of quantized kernels on subjective quality for long-context reranking — request Redwood to include sample-quality diffs in perf deliverable.
- Sales notes (short):
  * Highly technical buyer (infra/ML engineering). Engage SE on all calls.
  * Good fit for Dedicated + Optimize; Private deployment not required initially.
  * Upsell path: Managed on-prem nodes for EU customers in 12-18m horizon.
- Next steps (reiterated): schedule Dedicated perf run week of 2026-03-15; confirm billing sandbox and VPN/VPC peering details; collect Nebulon replay dataset (NEB-REPLAY-v3).
